CustomField.formula:
CASE( TEXT(LicenseType__r.RenewalMailToCode__c) , "B - Business Mailing/Business/Residence", IF( IsMailingPopulated__c = "Y", MailingCity__c, IF(IsBusinessPopulated__c = "Y", BusinessCity__c, ResidenceCity__c)),
"R - Residence Mailing/Residence", IF( IsMailingPopulated__c = "Y", MailingCity__c, IF(IsResidencePopulated__c = "Y", ResidenceCity__c, null)),
"E - Employer If licensee is inactive, licensee’s Mailing/Residence. Otherwise, c/o Employer’s Mailing/Business", IF(
OR ( TEXT(ActiveInactive__c) = "Inactive", IsEmployerAddressPopulated__c = "N" ),
IF( IsMailingPopulated__c = "Y", MailingCity__c, IF(IsResidencePopulated__c = "Y", ResidenceCity__c, null)),
EmployerCity__c
),
NULL)
CustomField.label: Renewal Mail To City
